MACD histogram improved to -0.1618 but remains bearish. 5-day low $73.61, 20-day low $72.13 suggest potential Higher Low pattern. Volume ratio at 0.37, indicating contraction. Price below SMA20 ($84.19) and SMA200 ($83.55) in a sideways trend. ATR $3.89 (4.76%) implies stop loss range of $5.06-$15.56 (1.3x-4.0x ATR). With current price at $81.80, a 1.3x ATR stop loss would be $71.24 and a 2.6x ATR target $92.36, yielding a 1.67 risk-reward ratio. Weekly RSI at 45.9 and MACD histogram at -2.2734 show bearishness. ADX at 31.9 indicates a trend, but -DI (34.0) is stronger than +DI (21.9). Overall, lack of clear direction and persistent weakness suggest a wait-and-see approach.
